q: If the equilibrium constant is _______ than 1, the equilibrium lies to the right, and there are more products than reactants. [2024]
e: When the equilibrium constant is greater than 1, product formation is favored at equilibrium.

q: If the external factors are altered, the system will shift to a _______ state of equilibrium. [2025]
e: According to Le Chatelier's principle, altering external conditions causes the system to adjust until a new equilibrium state is established.

q: _______ is a system that allows energy to enter and exist, but matter can neither be gained or lost. [2026]
e: A closed system can exchange energy (heat and work) with its surroundings, but cannot exchange matter.

q: At _______, the rates of forward and reverse reactions are equal. [2024]
e: Dynamic chemical equilibrium is reached when the rates of the forward and reverse reactions become equal.

q: If the K_eq value is _______, the equilibrium lies to the right and there are more products than reactants. [2025]
e: A large equilibrium constant (K_eq >> 1) indicates that products predominate at equilibrium.

q: A _______ reaction is a reaction that can proceed in both directions. [2026]
e: A reversible reaction can proceed in both forward and reverse directions under identical conditions.

q: If the K_eq value is _______, the equilibrium lies to the left. [2024]
e: When K_eq is less than 1, the reaction favors the reactants at equilibrium.

q: In equilibrium the forward and reverse reactions are still proceeding at an equal _______. [2025]
e: Chemical equilibrium is dynamic, meaning both forward and reverse processes continue simultaneously at the exact same rate.

q: The equilibrium constant provides how far a reaction has gone towards _______ before it reaches equilibrium. [2026]
e: The magnitude of K_eq indicates the extent to which reactants are converted into products before reaching equilibrium.

q: The equilibrium constant K_p can be given as the ratio of the _______ of products and reactants. [2024]
e: For gas-phase reactions, K_p is expressed as the ratio of the partial pressures of products to reactants.

q: There are two types of equilibrium; _______ equilibrium and dynamic equilibrium. [2025]
e: Equilibrium can be broadly categorized into static equilibrium (no movement) and dynamic equilibrium (equal opposing rates).

q: Le Chatelier's principle is a _______ guide to the effect of changes in concentration, temperature and pressure on a system at equilibrium. [2026]
e: Le Chatelier's principle provides a qualitative prediction of how a system responds to changes in conditions.

q: Closed system allows energy to enter and exit, but _______ can neither be gained nor lost. [2024]
e: Matter cannot cross the boundary of a closed system, while energy transfer remains possible.

q: Reversible reactions that happen in a _______ system eventually reach equilibrium. [2025]
e: A closed system prevents reactants or products from escaping, allowing the system to achieve equilibrium.

q: When the concentration of a reactant is increased on equilibrium system, the system responds by _______ the concentration of the reactant. [2026]
e: The system relieves stress by consuming (removing) the added reactant to restore equilibrium.

q: If a reversible reaction is in a closed system, the system can reach a state called a _______ equilibrium. [2024]
e: In a closed system, a reversible reaction eventually establishes dynamic equilibrium.

q: In many equilibrium systems, the substances involved are _______ all in the same phase. [2025]
e: In heterogeneous equilibria, reactants and products exist in two or more different phases.

q: In methanol production, the reaction is carried out at a temperature of 250°C using the catalyst _______. [2026]
e: Industrial synthesis of methanol utilizes a copper-zinc oxide-alumina catalyst.

q: If the number of moles of gas is the same on both sides of the reversible chemical equation, _______ has no effect. [2024]
e: When Δn_gas = 0, changes in overall pressure do not shift the equilibrium position.

q: Fuels are burned in air to produce carbon dioxide and water, and this reaction goes to _______. [2025]
e: Combustion reactions are irreversible and proceed fully until the limiting reactant is completely consumed.

q: The equilibrium in which the reactants and products of a chemical equilibrium are all in a single phase is called _______ equilibrium. [2026]
e: A homogeneous equilibrium is one in which all reacting species are present in the same physical phase.
